text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":12,"why":"Patient reported that the diarrhea started three days ago."},{"i":1,"v":"INFERRED","u":27,"why":"Patient mentioned abdominal pain, which is inferred to be associated with the diarrhea."},{"i":2,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":32,"why":"Patient explicitly denied blood and mucus in the stool."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":23,"why":"Patient reported vomiting once."},{"i":4,"v":"INFERRED","u":28,"why":"Patient described the diarrhea as 'like a little bit of abdominal pain' and 'a little bit of abdominal pain' and 'water'."},{"i":5,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":39,"why":"Patient mentioned a slight fever."},{"i":6,"v":"INFERRED","u":43,"why":"Patient reported a loss of appetite."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":62,"why":"Patient mentioned having asthma."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":60,"why":"Patient mentioned his father's history of hypertension and death from bowel cancer ten years ago."},{"i":9,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient mentioned using Lexapro, not Lapriso."},{"i":10,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":80,"why":"Patient explicitly denied any allergies."},{"i":11,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"While the doctor suggested gastroenteritis, the patient did not confirm this diagnosis."}]}
